reconciled_findings: Official OUSD is a Bridge Building Inc.-issued Open Standard stablecoin, operated by Open Standard.
Coinbase's official OpenUSD asset page identifies the official four-network contract set and says the asset is available on Coinbase's centralized exchange.
A separate Coinbase DEX guide for a token named Open Standard with ticker OUSD refers to a different Solana mint and a roughly $0.0000055 token. It is not the official $1 OpenUSD contract.
The Solscan supply is the Solana-chain component only; Coinbase's 909M supply is a rounded platform aggregate. Do not subtract or average these figures without cross-chain accounting.
The Tempo explorer showed no transactions/transfers at retrieval. Treat that as a scoped explorer observation, not a network-wide inactivity conclusion.
The official OUSD network list does not include XRPL. No XRP bridge use, XRP purchases, XRP collateral or XRP settlement volume is established by these sources.

SBI/Startale's JPYSC-OUSD interoperability work remains an exploratory PoC; JPYSC public-chain distribution was still described as future in SBI's November 2 release. The OUSD listing does not turn the JPYSC-OUSD PoC into a live XRP route.
